BrochureContent.Content:
Sheehy Meares Real Estate are delighted to present 27 Rath Bawn, Portnick, Ballinasloe, Co. Galwa, a beautifully maintained four-bedroom semi-detached residence presented in turnkey condition.

Situated within a mature residential estate, the property enjoys an excellent location just minutes? walk from Ballinasloe town centre and its wide range of shops, schools, cafés and local amenities.

The ground-floor accommodation comprises a welcoming entrance hallway, a bright kitchen and dining area, utility room, guest WC and a comfortable living room featuring a solid fuel stove. Upstairs, there is a landing area, hot press, four well proportioned bedrooms, a main family bathroom and an ensuite.

Externally, the property features a small front garden and off street parking for two cars. To the rear is a beautifully presented garden with side access, mature shrubbery, a garden shed and an attractive patio area complete with a pergola, providing an ideal space for outdoor dining and entertaining.

The property benefits from gas fired central heating, mains water, mains sewerage and a C3 BER rating.

This turnkey home offers spacious accommodation in a convenient and highly sought after residential location.

Contact Cathal Meares of Sheehy Meares Real Estate to arrange your viewing.
